summary: Lists the signed-in fan's crews and creates a new crew.
purpose: Lets fans see their crews and start a new one.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the two common crew actions.
how: GET confirms sign-in and returns the user's crews. POST confirms sign-in, checks the body holds a crew name, creates the crew and returns it with status 201.
inputs: GET with the session. POST with a JSON body holding a crew name.
outputs: A JSON list of crews for GET. The new crew for POST.
risks: The name length and content rules are in the shared schema, not this file.
